title: Optional native-canvas composition lock for one person's card

rectangle.description: Normalized left, top, right, bottom; origin is the canvas top-left. Left/top must be smaller than right/bottom.

source_prototype_sha256.description: Optional selected-prototype checksum; verified by the assembler when that local reference is supplied.

subject_center_region.description: Allowed region for the alpha-weighted center of the whole subject; this is not a face or semantic-focus detector.

text_safe_regions.description: Only explicitly selected text spaces are checked for foreground alpha occupancy.

max_text_overlap.description: Maximum occupied pixel fraction of subject/spirit/effects in each explicit text-safe region; default is 0.05.
